manifest.name: @xbzbing/dsh-git-panel
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin: an IDE-style Git panel in the Web GUI — branch/history overview, uncommitted changes with commit & amend, diff stats, and a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar.

scripts.test:e2e: node build.mjs && node test/e2e/setup.mjs && node test/e2e/all.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test

bundle.text:
# dsh-git-panel bundle patch: insert the host half as one cordis row.
# The package's dsh.bundle.patch points here; the row's host half
# (lib/host/index.js) loads as a plain cordis plugin, and the dsh.client
# metadata composes the browser half (lib/client.js).
- insert:
    - id: git-panel
      name: '@xbzbing/dsh-git-panel'
      config:
        timeoutMs: 8000
        maxBytes: 4194304
        maxChanges: 1000
        refreshIntervalMs: 30000
        defaultDiffView: unified

readme.text:
[English](https://github.com/xbzbing/dsh-git-panel/blob/main/README.en.md) | 简体中文

`dsh-git-panel` 是一个 DSH Web GUI 插件，在对话工作区里提供 IDE 风格的 Git 面板。它把分支列表、提交历史图、未提交变更的提交与 amend、语法高亮的差异对照集中到一个常驻标签页，并在输入框左侧放一个 zsh 风格的分支标记，让你在对话过程中随手查看仓库状态、提交改动，不必切到终端或另开 IDE。

面板只读取当前会话工作目录所在的 Git 仓库，所有 git 命令都以 argv 数组经宿主的 subprocess 服务执行，不拼接 shell 字符串，工作目录锁定在仓库根，并带超时与输出上限。插件不改动 git 配置，写操作（提交、amend、暂存、丢弃）都有明确入口。
```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @xbzbing/dsh-git-panel@latest

readme.section: 预发布（GitHub Release 附件，不发 npm）
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/xbzbing/dsh-git-panel/releases/download/v1.8.0-rc.1/xbzbing-dsh-git-panel-1.8.0-rc.1.tgz
```

预发布版本号带 `-`（如 `1.8.0-rc.1`），只发 GitHub Release、不发 npm，也不会触发面板里的「有新版本」提示。仓库不提交 `lib/`，所以不能用 `dsh plugin add github:…` 安装。

首次安装后，工作区标签栏会直接出现 **Git** 面板，无需重启或刷新页面。更新时，只改了 client 端的版本立即生效；含 host 端改动的版本需重启 dsh。详情页的配置改动即时生效。

> **兼容性**：已在 `dsh@0.2.1-rc.2` 与 `dsh@0.2.2-alpha.2` 上实测，安装、Git 面板、输入框标记、host RPC 与插件详情页均可正常使用。

- **Git 总览**：分支 / 标签列表、提交历史图和提交详情，点文件即看该提交里的差异。历史支持“消息 / 哈希”和“文件 / 路径”两种搜索；文件 / 路径按历史路径做不区分英文大小写的字面子串匹配，文件名和目录片段都可搜，作者、日期、分支筛选继续叠加。该搜索只匹配路径、不搜代码内容，已删除路径仍可命中，改名不会自动追溯旧名。Git 默认的路径历史可能简化部分合并与支线，提交详情仍显示完整文件列表。
- **变更记录**：逐文件或批量暂存、放弃，提交与 **Amend**，贮藏，增删行统计；列表可切「平铺 / 树形」两种视图（树形按目录折叠、汇总每个目录的变更数，可整目录暂存或放弃，重命名显示旧路径），默认平铺、可在插件配置中改，操作栏尾部的一个图标随时切换（图标即当前视图，空间不足时自动隐藏）。勾选按行记「侧」：只勾暂存侧的那一行就按 index 现有内容提交（不会把工作区未暂存的改动再 `git add` 进来，`git add -p` 的部分暂存得以保留），勾工作区侧则按整份文件提交。
- **常用 Git 操作**：切换分支、增删标签、还原 / 重置提交；破坏性操作需二次确认，只改本地仓库、不自动推送。
- **AI 生成提交信息**：参照仓库既有提交风格生成，模型默认跟随当前会话，可在详情页固定。**生成会把 diff 内容发送给所选模型的供应商。**
- **输入框 Git 标记**：zsh 风格的 `<仓库名> (<分支>)`，绿色为已同步、橙色为有未提交变更，点击跳转面板。空白对话尚未渲染视图标签栏时，点击改为打开右侧边栏的 Git 页签；侧边栏已展开且其中只有 Git 页时，再次点击收起侧边栏（还有其它页时仍只跳到 Git 页）。侧边栏入口也不可用时会提示先发送第一条消息。
- **多仓库切换**：自动识别 worktree 与子目录里的独立仓库，切换后总览、变更记录和输入框标记都作用于所选仓库；点行切换后列表保持展开，连续换仓库不用再点一次，切回读过的仓库直接换回它上一次的内容。
- **文件浏览**：浏览工作区目录树，预览代码、Markdown（含 mermaid 图表）、HTML 与图片；默认以项目根为根，也可随 Git 切换换根；非 Git 目录同样可用。配置与文档类文件（json / yaml / xml / properties / md / txt / toml / conf / ini / cfg、`.gitignore` 等）可以直接编辑保存。
- **右键菜单**：文件、目录、预览图片、分支、提交、变更、贮藏、仓库行和输入框 Git 标记都能右键。文件与目录借用侧边栏的公开动作——在浮窗打开、在 Finder 中显示、用默认应用打开（带应用图标）、复制路径、下载 / 另存为（没有「在侧栏打开」）；diff 两侧的

- **Git 命令**：所有 git 命令都经宿主的 `subprocess` 服务执行——argv 数组、不拼接 shell 字符串、工作目录锁定在仓库根，每条命令带超时与输出上限；不使用 `--force`，也不改动 git 配置。
- **文件访问**：只读工作区内的文件（差异、文件浏览、AI 生成的输入），路径经校验并做 realpath 包含检查——软链指向仓库外一律拒绝，`.git` 不可浏览。插件只有两种写盘动作：
  - 「放弃未跟踪条目」：按你的确认直接删除工作区文件，条目本身是 Git 仓库时整批拒绝。
  - 在文件浏览中编辑已有文件：只限 `json` `yaml` `yml` `xml` `properties` `md` `markdown` `txt` `toml` `conf` `ini` `cfg` 与 `.gitignore` `.gitattributes` `.editorconfig` `.env`，单个文件不超过 2 MiB、UTF-8 编码，只读文件不可编辑。`.env` 与 `.env.local` 等 `.env.*` 变体可编辑（它们通常含密钥）。保存时先比对文件版本，编辑期间文件被 AI 或其他程序改过就不会直接覆盖；写入经临时文件原子替换，保留换行风格、BOM 与权限位。可在插件配置「基础配置」里关闭。
- **网络**：插件自身只发起一个请求——`GET https://api.github.com/repos/<owner>/<repo>/releases/latest`，用于版本条上的「有新版本」提示（5 秒超时，结果带进程内缓存）。`fetch` / `pull` / `push` / `publish` 只在你点击后经 git 命令联网，凭据始终由 git 处理；插件不读取、不存储、不返回任何令牌或凭据。
- **外部服务**：只有「AI 生成提交信息」会把 diff 内容发送给你在 DSH 中配置的模型供应商；模型调用由宿主完成，插件不持有凭据。
- **系统依赖**：需要 `git` CLI；未安装 git 或目录不是 Git 仓库时只显示文件浏览，以当前工作目录为根。
客户端 bundle（`lib/client.js`）不发起网络请求，只与宿主走同源 RPC；插件不采集遥测。面板字号、分栏宽度这类界面偏好只存在浏览器 localStorage，不含仓库内容。除 git 命令、被确认的删除与你保存的编辑外，插件代码不写任何文件，也不在工作区之外读文件；详情页的配置项由宿主写进 profile 配置。

| Git 总览 | 文件差异 modal |
| :---: | :---: |
|  |  |
| 变更记录 | 文件浏览 |
|  |  |
| 窄面板 / 移动端 | 插件配置 |
|  |  |

插件分 host / client 两半，通过 typert Remote 网关通信。

- **Host**（`lib/host/`）：`gitPanel` 命名空间上的 Cordis + typert `GitPanelService`，暴露 `snapshot` / `run` / `query` / `suggest` / `version` 五个端点，仅做端点委托与生命周期接线；git 命令经宿主 `subprocess` 服务执行（argv 数组、无 shell、cwd 锁仓库根、超时 + 输出上限）；`suggest` 端点经宿主 `llm` 服务用你已配置的模型一次性生成提交信息。
- **Client**（`lib/client.js`）：一个 React 包，注册 `conversation.view` 面板和 `conversation.input.left` 标记。每会话一个快照控制器（轮询 + turn 完成后刷新 + 连接重置重拉），标记、变更记录页和统计条共用同一份快照，避免重复 git 命令。

```bash
node build.mjs      # tsc（host d.ts）+ esbuild（host 逐模块 js + client bundle + testkit）
npm run typecheck   # 类型检查
npm run test:unit   # 纯算法与 host 端点单测（node --test）
npm run test:e2e    # 隔离的 file:// 无头浏览器 e2e（不碰任何运行中的实例）

host 产物按 `src/host/` 逐模块输出（一个源文件一个 js，堆栈直接落在出问题的模块），且不做压缩：typert 网关靠方法参数名做参数校验，压缩会改名并破坏 wire 契约。client 改动有热重载：重新构建 `lib/client.js` 后，运行中的 dsh 秒级检测到文件变化并推给浏览器原地热替换，无需刷新页面；host 半改动仍需重启（已加载的旧代码跑到重启为止）。`lib/` 是本地构建产物、不入库；本地联调：把插件加入 dsh web profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，用 `file:` 依赖指向本目录，`node build.mjs` 后即生效。

```text
src/
  host/
    types.ts        wire 数据模型的唯一权威源（client 直接复用）
    index.ts        GitPanelService：端点委托与生命周期接线

感谢 [@ivanant](https://github.com/ivanant) 为项目提出的各种优化建议和迭代需求。移动端布局、变更记录的批量选择、AI 生成提交信息、提交图与图标的细节打磨、没有远程分支时的推送（publish）等改进，大多来自他持续反馈的真实使用场景；这些反馈把面板从「能用」推到了现在的形态。

感谢 [@QianYI-Yan](https://github.com/QianYI-Yan) 为工作区多仓库支持打下的基础（#83）：扫描工作区子目录里的独立仓库、RPC 请求带可选 `repo` 字段切换工作树、切换仓库时旧内容压暗等第一批实现都来自他的 PR（#85）；本版的 worktree 识别与文件浏览根都构建在这之上。

感谢 [@homily707](https://github.com/homily707) 为减少高频操作的打断所做的改进（#109）：快进拉取、快进推送和干净工作树下的切分支不再弹确认，直接执行；操作发起后才失败时，错误按发起时的仓库归属显示。PushModal 与 pull / push 的弹窗文案、预览查询也随之移除。
本项目采用 [MIT License](https://github.com/xbzbing/dsh-git-panel/blob/main/LICENSE)。

`dsh-git-panel` is a DSH Web GUI plugin that brings an IDE-style Git panel into the conversation workspace. It gathers the branch list, commit history graph, uncommitted-change commit & amend, and syntax-highlighted diffs into one resident tab, and puts a zsh-style branch marker at the left of the input bar — so you can check repo status and commit changes mid-conversation without switching to a terminal or a separate IDE.

The panel only reads the Git repository at the current session's working directory. Every git command runs through the host subprocess service as an argv array — no shell string concatenation — with the working directory locked to the repository root and per-command timeout and output caps. The plugin never touches your git config, and every write (commit, amend, stage, discard) has an explicit entry point.
```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @xbzbing/dsh-git-panel@latest

readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/xbzbing/dsh-git-panel/releases/download/v1.8.0-rc.1/xbzbing-dsh-git-panel-1.8.0-rc.1.tgz
```

Pre-release versions carry a `-` suffix (e.g. `1.8.0-rc.1`): they ship only as GitHub prereleases, never to npm, and never trigger the in-panel "update available" prompt. `lib/` is not committed, so `dsh plugin add github:…` does not work.

readme.text:
After a first install the **Git** panel appears in the workspace tab bar with no restart or page refresh. On update, a version that only changes the client half takes effect immediately; one that changes the host half needs a dsh restart. Settings on the detail page apply immediately.

> **Compatibility**: verified on `dsh@0.2.1-rc.2` and `dsh@0.2.2-alpha.2` — installation, the Git panel, the input-bar marker, the host RPC, and the plugin detail page all work normally.

- **Overview** — branch / tag list, commit history graph, and commit details; click a file to see its diff in that commit. History offers “message / hash” and “file / path” search. File / path search matches literal substrings in historical paths without distinguishing English letter case, including file names and directory fragments, while author, date and branch filters still combine with it. The search matches paths only, not code contents; deleted paths remain searchable and renames do not automatically follow the old name. Git may simplify parts of merge and side-branch history in the default path view; commit details still show the complete file list.
- **Changes** — stage and discard per file or in batches, commit and **Amend**, stash, and added·deleted statistics. The list switches between a flat and a folder-tree view (per-folder counts, folder-level stage / discard, renames show their old path); flat by default and configurable in the plugin settings, with a single switch icon on the action toolbar showing the view in use (it hides itself when space is tight). A pick carries the side it was made on: selecting only the staged row commits what the index already holds (no re
The panel runs with the DSH process's privileges. These are the boundaries worth knowing before installing:

- **Git commands** — every git command goes through the host `subprocess` service: argv arrays, no shell string concatenation, cwd locked to the repository root, with a per-command timeout and output caps. It never uses `--force` and never touches your git config.
- **File access** — it only reads files inside the workspace (diffs, file browser, the AI-suggestion input), after validation plus a realpath containment check: symlinks pointing outside the repository are refused and `.git` is not browsable. The plugin writes to disk in two ways only:
  - **Discarding an untracked entry** deletes the working-tree file after your confirmation, and refuses the whole batch when an entry is itself a Git repository.
  - **Editing an existing file in the file browser**, limited to `json` `yaml` `yml` `xml` `properties` `md` `markdown` `txt` `toml` `conf` `ini` `cfg` plus `.gitignore` `.gitattributes` `.editorconfig` `.env`, up to 2 MiB and UTF-8; read-only files stay read-only. `.env` and `.env.*` variants such as `.env.local` are editable (they usually hold secrets). A save first compares the file version, so a change the AI or another program made while you were editing is never silently ove

The client bundle (`lib/client.js`) makes no network requests of its own — it talks to the host over same-origin RPC — and the plugin collects no telemetry. UI-only preferences such as the panel font size and pane widths live in browser localStorage and never contain repository content. Apart from git commands, the confirmed deletion and the edits you save, the plugin's code writes no files and reads nothing outside the workspace; the detail-page settings are persisted by the host into the profile config.

| Overview | File-diff modal |
| :---: | :---: |
|  |  |
| Changes | File browser |
|  |  |
| Narrow / mobile | Plugin config |
|  |  |

- **Host** (`lib/host/`) — a Cordis + typert `GitPanelService` on the `gitPanel` namespace, exposing `snapshot` / `run` / `query` / `suggest` / `version` and doing only endpoint delegation and lifecycle wiring; git runs through the host `subprocess` service (argv arrays, no shell, cwd locked to the repository root, timeout + output caps); the `suggest` endpoint makes a one-shot commit-message call through the host `llm` service with your configured model.
- **Client** (`lib/client.js`) — a React bundle that registers the `conversation.view` panel and the `conversation.input.left` marker. One snapshot controller per session (polling + a refresh after each turn + a reload on connection reset) feeds the marker, the changes page, and the stats bar from a single snapshot, avoiding duplicate git commands.

```bash
node build.mjs      # tsc (host d.ts) + esbuild (per-module host js + client bundle + testkit)
npm run typecheck   # type check
npm run test:unit   # pure-algorithm and host-endpoint unit tests (node --test)
npm run test:e2e    # isolated file:// headless-browser e2e (never touches a running instance)

The host output is emitted one file per `src/host/` module (stack traces land in the module that raised) and is never minified: the typert gateway validates arguments by method parameter name, and minification would rename them and break the wire contract. Client changes are hot-reloaded: after rebuilding `lib/client.js`, the running dsh detects the file change within a second and pushes it to the browser for an in-place swap (old fiber torn down, new code remounted) — no page refresh needed; host changes still need a restart, since loaded modules keep running their previous code. `lib/` is local build output and is not committed; for local development, add the plugin to a dsh web profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` with a `file:` dependency pointing at this directory, then run `node build.mjs`.

```text
src/
  host/
    types.ts        the single source of truth for the wire data model (reused by the client)
    index.ts        GitPanelService: endpoint delegation + lifecycle wiring

Thanks to [@ivanant](https://github.com/ivanant) for the many optimization suggestions and iteration requests filed against this project. Mobile layout, batch selection in the changes page, AI commit messages, commit-graph and icon polish, and publishing a branch that has no upstream all came mostly from his real-world usage reports — feedback that moved the panel well past "it works".

Thanks to [@QianYI-Yan](https://github.com/QianYI-Yan) for the foundation of workspace multi-repo support (#83): scanning the workspace's subdirectories for independent repositories, carrying an optional `repo` field on every RPC request to switch work trees, and dimming the old contents while a switch is in flight — his PR (#85) was the first implementation of all three, and this release's worktree detection and file-browser roots are built on top of it.

Thanks to [@homily707](https://github.com/homily707) for removing the confirmation prompts from high-frequency operations (#109): fast-forward pull, fast-forward push, and switching branches on a clean worktree now run immediately; when an operation fails after it starts, the error is reported against the repository it came from. PushModal, the pull / push dialog copy, and their preview queries are gone as well.
